texts.6ab73949c491: The data supplied by the NHS IC to Causation Ltd will be used only for the approved Medical Research Project MR188.
texts.7167750ee4d8: Skin lesions have been identified in 20 workers manufacturing 4,4' - bipyridyl. A total of 629 employees and ex-employees of the three manufacturing plants have been identified, of whom over 550 have been examined or questioned. The pattern of incidence and the clinical symptons lead to an assumption that the lesions are all part of a single clinical entity. As the incidence is excessive for such as group of workers in the north-west of England, it has been concluded that the lesions are occupationally induced. 37 of the ex-employees are known to have died. A statistical analysis of their causes of death showed no abnormal trends. The priorities for future work are to continue to manage and contain the skin lesion epidemic, and to monitor the health of the cohort for any other adverse trends. Key elements in meeting these priorities will be the tracing of those members of the cohort as yet untraced, the tracking of those who subsequently leave employment, and prompt notification of cancer incidence and mortality.
